method: live profile composed through apps/cli/src/bin.ts --dump-config over a throwaway home whose profile node_modules is a junction to the live one
staged: junctioned node_modules to the live profile

digests.note: sourceDigest folds only the layer files whose real path is inside this repository, so a repository change moves it and a machine change does not. liveDigest folds the inputs this machine owns (the live profile own cordis.patch.yml and bundles installed outside the repository): it is recorded so a reader can see that the machine moved under the report, and no gate may turn on it - the application rewrites its own profile patch (measured in R40, R43 and R51).

limit: The dump is matched by id lines only: it does not evaluate !!js, and an id present in both does not mean the same config.
Scope is the profile composition (bundle layers then the profile layer). The home layer and --patch overlays apply after it (document.ts:159) and are not part of this comparison.
Only unindented ids count as rows; an id printed inside some entry config (an agent preset plugin list) is counted separately as idsInsideConfig.
